answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. By the jetty of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, expired if not renewed by fresh work, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Work waits on the mirror until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the relic of the next round.
